thread:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — partial responses + timeouts on /v1/stream. I summarized action items below, need owners and dates.

shilpa: Thanks. Can we split into short fixes vs longer infra work?

marty: Yep. Short fixes = client-side reconnect heuristics + cherry-picked runtime patch. Long = KV cache guardrails + improved tracing.

ana (ops-bot): Incident #INC-2026-042 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-042. Added initial timeline and attachments.

ana (ops-bot): Pager duty rotation noted: @ria on-call tomorrow.

ria: I can take reconnect logic improvements (client + server-safe fallback). Plan: quick client client-backoff bump + server idempotent-reconnect acceptance in 3 days.

sam: Assigned to @ria for reconnect work. Deliverables: 1) client SDK change (config flag + backoff default), 2) server handshake acceptance window.

shilpa: I'll own the runtime patch (reduce KV eviction race) — small PR to change eviction grace + add a metric. ETA: 4 business days.

marty: I'll own rollout and canary plan for the runtime fix + set auto-fallback to a lighter quantized variant if handshake fails.

jeff: Observability gap: we currently don't have request-level kv-cache-hit traces correlated with streaming handshakes. Ana, can we add a trace tag and a dashboard?

ana (ops-bot): Trace job created: trace/prod/stream-handshake.

ana (ops-bot): Log snippet from last incident attached to the ticket: 
```
2026-03-22T21:34:02Z stream: handshake accepted id=abcd1234
2026-03-22T21:34:03Z stream: kvcache-evict key=conv:97 reason=mem_pressure
2026-03-22T21:34:03Z stream: partial-response session=abcd1234 err=timeout
```

ana (ops-bot): Added runbook note: when partial-response pattern seen, check KV eviction rate and client reconnect jitter.

ana (ops-bot): Tagging recurring pattern flag: streaming-partial-responses.

ana (ops-bot): Suggested short mitigation: enable client-side resend on reconnect (idempotency token) + server-side 500ms buffer to accept reconnections.

ana (ops-bot): Suggested longer term: reserve small in-memory cache per active session to avoid eviction on short conversations.

ana (ops-bot): Added label: followup-priority=high.

ana (ops-bot): Linked previous incidents: INC-2025-311, INC-2025-412 (pattern match 82%).

ana (ops-bot): Auto-assign proposal: 
- reconnect: ria
- runtime-guard: shilpa
- observability: ana
- rollout: marty

ria: Implementation notes: client SDK patch will default to exponential backoff with jitter and will expose RECONNECT_MAX_MS. Example snippet: 
```
// client reconnect snippet
const cfg = { RECONNECT_BASE_MS: 200, RECONNECT_MAX_MS: 2000, JITTER: 0.2 }
await stream.connect(cfg)
```

shilpa: Runtime patch will add metric `kv_evictions_per_min` and a telemetry spike alert > 15/min for a host. Also adding a short mutex around cache invalidation to avoid races.

marty: Rollout plan: canary 5% for 24h, if error rate stable -> 25% for 24h -> full. Auto-fallback: if stream error rate increases by >30% in canary, route to quantized-variant for affected customers.

jeff: Observability request: dashboard should include: handshake_time, kv_evictions_per_min, partial_response_rate, reconnect_rate, latency_p50/p95. Also add log sampling for sessions that saw partial responses.

ana (ops-bot): Action item checklist created in INC ticket.

sam: Deadlines — short fixes: reconnect client + server buffer, runtime grace patch, dashboard + alert. Target: 5 business days for code + canary. Longer term in roadmap: per-session in-memory reserve + KV compaction improvements (Q2).

ria: I'll open PRs today for client and server handshake tolerance.

shilpa: I'll start runtime PR tomorrow morning.

ana (ops-bot): Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 3 business days @ 10:00am.

marty: I'll add a row to the SLO tracker noting this incident pattern and expected regression windows.

jeff: One more ask — add regression test in playback harness that reproduces partial-response pattern by forcing eviction during active stream.

sam: Good call. Assigning test to jeff. ETA 3 days.

ria: Confirmed: I'll include idempotency token acceptance in server to allow client resends without duplicate side effects.

ana (ops-bot): Current action owners summary: reconnect=ria (3d), runtime=shilpa (4d), observability=ana (2d), tests=jeff (3d), rollout=marty (ongoing).

sam: Thanks all. We'll review progress at the sync — bring PR links and canary gating criteria. :thumbsup:
